text: そこで　おまえ　たちには　わしの　かわりに　ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！

structure.jp: ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！
structure.en: I want (you) to fulfil the dream!

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a て-form verb says you want someone else to do it; that person gets に. はたして　ほしい = 'I want you to fulfil it'.

patterns.name: 〜のかわりに
patterns.explanation: のかわりに after a person says 'instead of' that person. わしの　かわりに = 'in my place'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence sound like an explanation. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. ほしいのじゃ = 'the thing is, I want it'.
